notes.title: The Double-Feature bundle: ARIJIGOKU & Primordial Fate!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I'm excited to announce that both of my games - [b][i]ARIJIGOKU[/i][/b] and [b][i]Primordial Fate[/i][/b] - are now available together in [b]The Double-Feature Bundle![/b][/p][p][/p][p]As a thank you for everyone's support, the bundle is available at a 15% discount! Whether you're diving into the psychological depths of [b][i]ARIJIGOKU[/i][/b] or exploring the cosmic horrors of [b][i]Primordial Fate[/i][/b], this is the perfect time to experience both.[/p][p][/p][p]Grab the bundle here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56146/The_DoubleFeature_Bundle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This offer is a great way for new players to jump into both worlds, or to complete your collection at a discount.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for all your support![/p][p][/p][p]David Blomme[/p][p]Sopheli Games[/p]
